blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — ferumoxytol infusion hypersensitivity precautions
stem: A client is scheduled to receive intravenous ferumoxytol. Which safety plan is most consistent with the current product label?

options.A: Infuse ferumoxytol over at least 15 minutes with personnel and anaphylaxis treatment immediately available, then observe the client for at least 30 minutes after the infusion.
options.B: Infuse ferumoxytol over at least 15 minutes and omit post-infusion observation when a prior dose was tolerated without a hypersensitivity reaction.
options.C: Infuse ferumoxytol over at least 15 minutes with emergency treatment available, then end hypersensitivity observation 15 minutes after the infusion is completed.
options.D: Infuse ferumoxytol over at least 15 minutes and observe for 30 minutes afterward, but emergency treatment availability is unnecessary after a previously tolerated dose.

rationale: The current FERAHEME boxed warning and §5.1 require administration as an IV infusion over at least 15 minutes when personnel and therapies are immediately available to treat anaphylaxis or other hypersensitivity reactions. Clients should be observed for hypersensitivity during the infusion and for at least 30 minutes afterward, including blood-pressure and pulse monitoring. Reactions have occurred despite tolerance of a previous dose. Therefore A is the best answer. B incorrectly removes post-infusion observation after a tolerated dose. C shortens the required post-infusion observation period. D incorrectly removes the requirement for immediate availability of personnel and therapies after prior tolerance.
educational_objective: Administer ferumoxytol over at least 15 minutes with personnel and therapies immediately available for anaphylaxis, and observe for hypersensitivity during and for at least 30 minutes after each infusion even when a previous dose was tolerated.
source_organization: DailyMed (U.S. National Library of Medicine); AMAG Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
source_document_title: FERAHEME (ferumoxytol injection), for intravenous use — Prescribing Information
source_locator: Boxed Warning — Risk for Serious Hypersensitivity/Anaphylaxis Reactions; Dosage and Administration §2; Warnings and Precautions §5.1 Serious Hypersensitivity Reactions: administer only as an IV infusion over at least 15 minutes with personnel and therapies immediately available; observe during and for at least 30 minutes after infusion with blood-pressure and pulse monitoring; reactions can occur after a previously tolerated dose.
source_claim_supported: Ferumoxytol requires an IV infusion over at least 15 minutes with immediate anaphylaxis-treatment capability and at least 30 minutes of post-infusion observation; previous tolerance does not remove hypersensitivity risk.
blueprint_locator: Printed p. 38, Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies: administer parenteral medications safely; monitor IV infusions and sites; assess adverse effects; evaluate medication response and intervene for complications.
candidate_reasons_resolved: Rewrote all four options as parallel ferumoxytol safety plans with comparable lengths.
Removed the isolated absolute-word cue and the uniquely longest correct-answer pattern.
Made each distractor partially plausible but specifically inconsistent with one boxed-warning requirement, preserving a single best answer.
audit_note: Independent second-pass review confirms A is uniquely complete and label-consistent. B omits required observation after prior tolerance, C shortens the post-infusion observation period, and D removes the immediate emergency-treatment requirement. No second defensible answer or material cueing remains.
